annotations.text:
The Merchants page in the Stores-Studio language:
· emerald replaces the stray blue; impersonation is a quiet outline button, not the loudest thing on the page
· one joined card: queue left, detail right, emerald edge on the active row
· status = a dot in the list, one chip in the detail (was shown 3 times)
· stat chips in the page header (total / confirmed / pending)
· empty fields say 'Not added yet' instead of a bare dash
· store rows match the Studio: tile, slug in mono, OWNER chip, Storefront link
· people are fictional samples
